mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_status = 'NORMAL'

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.project_id AS projectId, o.session_id AS sessionId, p.project_status AS projectStatus, s.session_status AS sessionStatus, p.title AS title, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, o.delivery_type AS deliveryType, ( SELECT q.delivery_mode FROM ticket_source_order_bridge b JOIN ticket_source_order_quote q ON q.quote_id = b.quote_id WHERE b.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 1 ) AS deliveryMode, item_stat.skuSummary AS skuSummary, item_stat.totalQuantity AS totalQuantity, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, CASE WHEN o.delivery_type = 'PAPER_TICKET' THEN item_stat.totalQuantity ELSE COALESCE(ticket_stat.ticket_count, 0) END AS ticketCount, ( SELECT et2.ticket_id FROM electronic_ticket et2 WHERE et2.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY CASE et2.ticket_status WHEN 'UNUSED' THEN 1 WHEN 'GENERATING' THEN 2 WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 3 WHEN 'CHECKED' THEN 4 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END, et2.ticket_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS defaultTicketId, CASE WHEN o.delivery_type = 'PAPER_TICKET' AND s.end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.end_time <= NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN o.delivery_type = 'PAPER_TICKET' AND o.order_status = 'WAIT_USE' THEN 'UNUSED' WHEN o.delivery_type = 'PAPER_TICKET' THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE ( SELECT CASE WHEN s.end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.end_time <= NOW() AND et3.ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE et3.ticket_status END FROM electronic_ticket et3 WHERE et3.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.end_time <= NOW() AND et3.ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN 5 WHEN et3.ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN 1 WHEN et3.ticket_status = 'GENERATING' THEN 2 WHEN et3.ticket_status = 'ERROR' THEN 3 WHEN et3.ticket_status = 'CHECKED' THEN 4 WHEN et3.ticket_status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END, et3.ticket_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) END AS ticketStatus, CASE WHEN s.end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.end_time <= NOW() THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN o.delivery_type = 'PAPER_TICKET' AND o.order_status = 'WAIT_USE' THEN 'UNUSED' WHEN o.delivery_type = 'PAPER_TICKET' THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN COALESCE(ticket_stat.unused_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'UNUSED' ELSE 'UNAVAILABLE' END AS displayStatus, o.create_time AS createTime FROM ticket_order o JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id JOIN ( SELECT order_id, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(sku_name, ' x', quantity) ORDER BY order_item_id SEPARATOR '；') AS skuSummary, SUM(quantity) AS totalQuantity FROM order_item GROUP BY order_id ) item_stat ON item_stat.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, COUNT(ticket_id) AS ticket_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unused_count FROM electronic_ticket GROUP BY order_id ) ticket_stat ON ticket_stat.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_status IN ('WAIT_USE', 'REFUNDING', 'FINISHED', 'REFUND_SUCCESS') ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.order_id DESC

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.project_id AS projectId, o.session_id AS sessionId, p.title AS title, p.poster_url AS posterUrl, s.city_name AS cityName, s.station_name AS stationName, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, v.venue_name AS venueName, v.address AS venueAddress, v.longitude AS venueLongitude, v.latitude AS venueLatitude, o.delivery_type AS deliveryType, ( SELECT q.delivery_mode FROM ticket_source_order_bridge b JOIN ticket_source_order_quote q ON q.quote_id = b.quote_id WHERE b.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 1 ) AS deliveryMode, item_stat.totalQuantity AS totalQuantity, o.pay_amount AS payAmount, ( SELECT et2.ticket_id FROM electronic_ticket et2 WHERE et2.order_id = o.order_id ORDER BY CASE et2.ticket_status WHEN 'UNUSED' THEN 1 WHEN 'GENERATING' THEN 2 WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 3 WHEN 'CHECKED' THEN 4 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END, et2.ticket_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS defaultTicketId FROM ticket_order o JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = o.project_id JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id JOIN ( SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS totalQuantity FROM order_item GROUP BY order_id ) item_stat ON item_stat.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT et.ticket_id AS ticketId, et.ticket_no AS ticketNo, et.order_id AS orderId, et.order_item_id AS orderItemId, et.order_audience_id AS orderAudienceId, CASE WHEN s.end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.end_time <= NOW() AND et.ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE et.ticket_status END AS ticketStatus, et.credential_type AS credentialType, et.dynamic_qr_mode AS dynamicQrMode, et.credential_version AS credentialVersion, CASE WHEN s.end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.end_time <= NOW() AND et.ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN NULL ELSE et.credential_expire_time END AS credentialExpireTime, et.refresh_after_seconds AS refreshAfterSeconds, CASE WHEN s.end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.end_time <= NOW() AND et.ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN NULL WHEN et.credential_type = 'DYNAMIC_QR' THEN NULL WHEN et.credential_type = 'STATIC_QR' THEN COALESCE(et.qr_code_value, et.credential_payload) WHEN et.credential_type IN ('SMS_CODE','EXCHANGE_CODE','URL','TEXT') THEN et.credential_payload ELSE NULL END AS credentialDisplayValue, CASE WHEN s.end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.end_time <= NOW() AND et.ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN NULL WHEN et.credential_type = 'STATIC_QR' THEN COALESCE(et.qr_code_value, et.credential_payload) ELSE NULL END AS qrCodeValue, et.seat_info AS seatInfo, et.entrance_info AS entranceInfo, et.generate_time AS generateTime, et.check_time AS checkTime, et.expire_time AS expireTime, et.abnormal_reason AS abnormalReason, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.sku_name AS skuName, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oa.real_name AS realName, oa.certificate_type AS certificateType, CASE WHEN oa.certificate_no IS NULL OR oa.certificate_no = '' THEN NULL WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(oa.certificate_no) <= 7 THEN '***' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(oa.certificate_no, 3), REPEAT('*', GREATEST(1, CHAR_LENGTH(oa.certificate_no) - 7)), RIGHT(oa.certificate_no, 4)) END AS maskedCertificateNo FROM electronic_ticket et JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id = et.order_id JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_item_id = et.order_item_id JOIN order_audience oa ON oa.order_audience_id = et.order_audience_id WHERE et.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.end_time IS NOT NULL AND s.end_time <= NOW() AND et.ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN 5 WHEN et.ticket_status = 'UNUSED' THEN 1 WHEN et.ticket_status = 'GENERATING' THEN 2 WHEN et.ticket_status = 'ERROR' THEN 3 WHEN et.ticket_status = 'CHECKED' THEN 4 WHEN et.ticket_status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END, et.ticket_id ASC
